title: Limitation Guardrail: Old 2020 Friendly Loan Barred by Limitation Act
input_narrative: I lent Rs 20,000 to my acquaintance Rajesh in January 2020 via Google Pay. He promised to repay within 2 months but never did. Now in 2026 I want to file a consumer court case or send a notice to recover this money.

key_facts: I lent Rs 20,000 to my acquaintance Rajesh in January 2020 via Google Pay
He promised to repay within 2 months but never did
Now in 2026 I want to file a consumer court case or send a notice to recover this money

timeline.event: Execution of contract / transaction and subsequent default by Opposite Party

evidence_gaps: Export complete WhatsApp / SMS conversation history as unedited text/PDF
Bank statement showing debit/credit entries with UTR numbers
Copy of rental agreement, purchase invoice, or employment appointment letter

legal_assessment.summary_verdict: Your claim involves civil breach of contractual promises and wrongful withholding of funds.

applicable_statutes.official_title: Compensation for Loss or Damage Caused by Breach of Contract
applicable_statutes.plain_meaning: When a contract is broken, the party who suffers is entitled to receive compensation for any loss or damage naturally arising from the breach.
applicable_statutes.maximum_penalty_or_relief: Full recovery of dues plus consequential damages and interest.

applicable_statutes.official_title: Statutory Period of Limitation for Recovery
applicable_statutes.plain_meaning: General civil recovery suits must be filed within 3 years from the date payment became due. Consumer complaints have a 2-year limitation (Section 69 CPA).
applicable_statutes.maximum_penalty_or_relief: Bar on judicial remedy if suit is not filed within the limitation period.

action_roadmap: Step 1: Issue a 15-day Pre-Litigation Legal Demand Notice.
Step 2: Initiate pre-institution mediation at the District Legal Services Authority (DLSA).
Step 3: File a civil recovery suit in the competent jurisdictional court.
legal_assessment.realistic_outcome: Statutory notice demonstrates bona fide attempt at dispute resolution before litigation.
risks_and_caveats: Ensure claim is within the 3-year statutory limitation period.
legal_assessment.legal_aid_option: Citizens with annual income below statutory limits (or women) are entitled to free state advocates via DLSA / NALSA.
